notes:
- Boosts: one-use bonuses you take into a game. Open BOOSTS in the main menu and pick up to 2 for your
  next game; they're used up when it starts (picks stay selected while you have more of that boost).
  - Head Start: start with 1,500 extra points.
  - On the House: your first perk is free.
  - Armory: start with a Vanguard AR as well as your pistol.
  - Pocket Frags: start with 2 extra grenades.
  - Lucky Box: your first Mystery Box spin is free.
  - Overtime: +25% XP from the game.
- Earning them: one random boost for every level you gain, every challenge and every daily challenge you
  complete. You get 3 to start with. The end-of-game screen shows the boosts you earned.
- In co-op a boost only helps the player who brought it.
- The perk machine and Mystery Box prompts say FREE while you have On the House / Lucky Box ready.
